summary:
Project Manager/BA with 16+ Years of Global Exp in Cards Portfolio, Payment, ATM & POS, and Regulatory compliance
Diversified 8+ Years of Onsite experience for clients in Bahrain, Brazil, Jamaica, Saudi Arabia, Spain, UAE, and U.S. etc.
Hands-on experience in Credit Card Issuing, ATM Acquiring, ISO 8583/ISO 20022 message integrations, Payment switches, Host integration, PCI DSS and ISO 27001, compliance, Cross Border Payment, Host to host payment, and API Banking
Experience full compliance with GCC Banking Regulations, ISO message validation, Card Scheme requirements (Visa/Mastercard), and Central Bank cybersecurity frameworks, resulting in secure and compliant payment experiences
Expertise in processes of EMV, contactless, CVV/CVC checks, 3DS upgrades, and authorization/clearing changes
Expertise in Wire message, Proprietary Format, SWIFT MT, Payment Scheme (US RTGS/SEPA/BACS/CHAPS/TARGET2)
Expertise in Cross Border Payment, H2H Integration, Payment Regulatory, Payment Migration (SWIFT MT to MX/ISO20022) Proven capability in leading scheme certifications, mandate upgrades, CR delivery, production support, integration, and ISO 8583 message handling across complex card and payments ecosystems
Experienced in CRS Reporting, AML, Due Diligence, Data Analysis, Data Warehouse, Data Conversion, Product Planning, Strategy Planning, Competitive Analysis
Expertise in Islamic Banks process e.g. Tahweel, Bai Bithaman Ajil, Bai Salam, Ijarah, Murabahah, Sukuk, and Wadiah etc.
Banking Portfolio and Financial Planning Life-cycle expertise including Islamic Banking, US Banks, and European Banks
Expert in complete Regulatory Reporting, Cards Portfolio Management for Financial Institutions that are Innovative, quick-to-market Instrument, and Products while serving Customers more efficiently, securely and profitably
Expertise in daily reconciliation, & dynamic payment processing manages issuance and complete lifecycle of transactions
Expertise in process improvement, End-to-End project management and technical solutions to meet business requirement, and managing the time and budget for the monthly releases, following Agile Methodology (SCRUM, and SAFe)
Expertise in developing Diagrams such as Use-Case, Activity, & Sequential and giving presentation to the Management
Reporting Solutions expertise including Islamic Banking, U.S. Financial Institutions, and Global Merchandisers
SPoC for Business Teams to Prioritize Business Requirements, Recommend Solutions, and Provide Technical Guidance
Validate and substantiate that new payment orchestration is accurate through Straight Through Processing
Leading the Design of Functional Test cases for Test Phases incl. Revenue Manager feature level Testing, SYS, INT, and UAT
Expertise in Preparing Technical Design Solution, Business Requirement Specifications, and Functional documents
